newsitem.title: BOSNIA: BOSNIA MAY OUTPUT DOWN 1.3 PCT M/M, UP 33.6 Y/Y.
newsitem.headline: BOSNIA MAY OUTPUT DOWN 1.3 PCT M/M, UP 33.6 Y/Y.

text.p: The Statistics Buraeu of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Monday.
BOSNIA INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION MAY APRIL MAY 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of the territory of Bosnia-Hercegovina. No data are available for remaining 49 percent. Bosnian industrial output is up 45.8 percent in Jan-May period compared to the same period in 1996, but May 1997 production is down 88.7 percent compared to the prewar May 1991 output, the office said. -- Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
